scope: Source-only review of reload instrumentation, reset action semantics, and receipt privacy; no tests, browser, build, or install run.

verdict_a.usefulness: Reload has distinct fixed stages for Page.reload, guest wait, Settings click, Account and Appearance expansion, default-state wait, storage read, and storage assertions. Failures retain a fixed category and lifecycle booleans; observed guest UI fields are booleans only. This narrows which reload boundary failed.
verdict_a.remaining_runtime: A reload that succeeds but stalls before a qualifying guest state records only the latest safe state read and condition_not_observed; it does not recover hidden runtime detail. Storage assertion failures share one stage and generic category, though their safe snapshot records presence and prior-key overlap counts.

verdict_b.source_quality: The existing trusted click, section-opening actions, and reset clearing/sign-out assertions remain the actual path and oracle; new wrappers observe failures without substituting success. CDP diagnostics persist availability/type/ready-state flags, and native diagnostics persist target/layout/hit/dialog/animation booleans plus fixed categories.
verdict_b.privacy: Raw error text is only inspected in memory to map to fixed categories. The outer catch emits fixed stage/category text. No raw exception, auth URL, page text, token/profile/settings value, or storage key is written to the receipt; storage evidence is booleans and counts. Diagnostic labels are fixed call-site literals.

verification: Inspected commit diff and current driver source only. No runtime verification performed by assignment.
